about.bio: I'm Carlos (Capi to my friends), a full stack developer based in Valencia. Before switching to code I spent 11+ years as a filmmaker and commercial director for clients like Apple, MSC Cruises and Snapchat, so I'm used to real clients, tight deadlines and work that has to ship. Today I build web and mobile products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL. Open to roles in Spain, remote, or relocation.

services.title: Frontend
services.desc: Interfaces in React and Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind, responsive and fast.

services.title: Backend & APIs
services.desc: REST APIs with Node.js and Express on PostgreSQL or MongoDB, using Prisma.

services.title: Mobile
services.desc: Mobile apps with React Native, Expo and Supabase, shipped to TestFlight.

experience.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Sole developer of a mobile app for a client company, built with React Native, Expo and Supabase, with AI features on the Claude API. Currently in TestFlight beta.

experience.title: Final project with a real client
experience.description: They ran everything on Notion, so our team built them a platform from scratch: a drag & drop dashboard with widgets for scheduling, calendar and a startup directory, developed together with the Data Science team. Finding information went from digging through Notion to one place.

experience.title: Filmmaker & Commercial Director
experience.description: Directed commercials and films for clients such as Apple, MSC Cruises and Snapchat, from client brief to final delivery.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
experience.description: I provided support for the university's equipment, as well as repaired, updated, and created local networks for students.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
experience.description: I provided support for police computer systems, created a local cloud-based storage system for them, and reinforced security to prevent intrusions.
